hostile-timed-controls.head: 21e9906c
hostile-timed-controls.scope: All seven cast on their assigned hostile NPCs and applied the expected state and duration. The earlier stock run confirmed the four immunity notices and cross-control refusal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/313#issuecomment-6998807737

targeted-heal-over-time.head: df867b77
targeted-heal-over-time.scope: Emergency Repairs on a wounded friendly player stored 16 HP and delivered five +3 ticks without a direct heal.

hostile-viral-direct.head: 21e9906c
hostile-viral-direct.scope: Logic Barrage 4.0 was blocked across the mapped sight gap and hit clear/resisted targets for 525/431. The prior 424/348 comparison is at https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/314#issuecomment-6999038685. Logic Barrage 1.0 targeted a hostile NPC successfully in PR312, and the PR321 Coder retest landed Static Blast outside interlock.

hostile-viral-area-dot.head: df867b77
hostile-viral-area-dot.scope: A flagged player deflected Plague Zone 2.0 and received no DOT. Six NPCs took the effect, with five ticks measured on WinterFrost and an NPC death and loot observed.

hacker-pulse-auras.head: 0c6c573e
hacker-pulse-auras.scope: Stock Actions toggled each aura, produced its expected child pulses and stopped it. Team overlap, recipient expiry, delayed FX and drain are separate checks.

sneak-toggle-detection.head: 15067ad8
sneak-toggle-detection.scope: Stock Sneak toggle, translucency, a low-awareness miss, a high-awareness reveal and the return to opaque presentation were observed. Reveal messaging remains open.

simulacrum-summons.head: b1cfc050
simulacrum-summons.scope: Stock Remote Proxy 5.0 and Logic Daemon 4.0 summoned the correct pets and showed Defensive assist, Passive stop and direct attack. Lower-rank 27 and 22 summons were observed in https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576.

simulacrum-detonation.head: 21e9906c
simulacrum-detonation.scope: Detonate refused a dummy as direct target, then damaged the nearby NPC and removed the selected own pet.

proxy-technician-pulses.head: b1cfc050
proxy-technician-pulses.scope: Stock Proxy Technician pulsed the logged +64 melee and ballistic bonuses. PR312 also observed upkeep and following a replacement summon. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576

awakened-timed-self-buffs.head: a4307878
awakened-timed-self-buffs.scope: Adrenaline Booster, Calm Mind Calm Body and Consistent Technique produced stock 20 s self buffs; expiry notices were observed for 1 and 5.

indefinite-self-stat-buffs.head: 6b21603c
indefinite-self-stat-buffs.scope: Stock status showed Hyper-Block defense and Determination. Hyper-Dodge and Hyper-Sprint toggle icons were observed in https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576.

timed-hacker-stat-buffs.head: 6b21603c
timed-hacker-stat-buffs.scope: Stock Upgrade Attacks showed +108 Viral Accuracy and cleared at expiry. PR312 observed Resist Combat and Force Enhancer applying. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576

timed-operative-buffs.head: a4307878
timed-operative-buffs.scope: Martial Arts Prowess and Find Weakness applied in the native operative sweep. PR485 e9c10a89 independently recorded Intensify adding +1 melee and ballistic, Firearms replacing it with +9 ballistic, then Prowess replacing Firearms with +40 melee for 20 seconds before natural expiry. pr485-PacketLog frames 915/993/1082/1311 prove the replacement order. The Prowess scaling function remains open.

hacker-vital-debuffs.head: 6b21603c
hacker-vital-debuffs.scope: Stock status showed IS regen dropping from 30 to 15 and HP regen from 25 to 20, with both restored at expiry. Max-vital UI values were not measured.

hyper-jump.head: a4307878
hyper-jump.scope: Stock aim and ground click sent the expected request and clock echo, and native/server NAV cell reports agreed.

hostile-awareness-query.head: a4307878
hostile-awareness-query.scope: Sixth Sense native chat gave 11 potential hostiles for the populated fixture location.

area-taunt.head: a4307878
area-taunt.scope: Stock Taunt produced threat and pursuit for the nearby NPC cluster.

caster-centered-viral-disruption.head: a4307878
caster-centered-viral-disruption.scope: The out-of-combat Area Disruption cast contested the nearby NPCs and landed on the logged successful recipients.

martial-style-selection.head: 4cf910ef
martial-style-selection.scope: Aikido selected and played its mid-interlock exchange set. The PR312 native sweeps exercised Self Defense, Karate and Kung-Fu. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-7000140962

gun-style-selection.head: 21e9906c
gun-style-selection.scope: Handguns, Rifles and SMG styles worked in the native Gunman fixture with their weapons equipped. The separate choreography swap issue remains open.

martial-interlock-specials.head: 21e9906c
martial-interlock-specials.scope: Punch Reversal auto-switched to Aikido and used animation 827; Wooden Dummy Drill used 8080. Additional stock queued specials landed in PR312, with their individual animation and proc caveats. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995363576 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-6995670186 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/312#issuecomment-7000140962

spy-throw-effects.head: a4307878
spy-throw-effects.scope: Native Wounding and Blinding Throw landed their timed effects; Poison Knife and Sever Artery landed out of combat after the stock client refused their interlock casts. PR424 confirms the selected Poison Knife applies 25-second ThrownDOT with 2-point ticks, and an empty selection receives a single invalid-target refusal. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/424

hyper-speed-movement.head: a4307878
hyper-speed-movement.scope: Hyper-Speed applied a 600 s stock HUD buff. The report did not measure the movement rate.

handgun-interlock-special.head: 21e9906c
handgun-interlock-special.scope: Pistol Aerial queued in an ordinary handgun interlock, used animation 9518 and applied its four-second stun.
